WITH account_order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order`
    GROUP BY account_id
), above_average AS (
    SELECT account_id, order_count,
           order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS above_overall_average
    FROM account_order_counts
    WHERE order_count > (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM account_order_counts)
)
SELECT account_id,
       order_count,
       above_overall_average,
       order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS above_average_accounts_difference
FROM above_average
ORDER BY above_average_accounts_difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
